text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By winning both the Yasuda Kinen and the Sprinters Stakes, Yamanin Zephyr proves her prowess in the sprint and mile tours.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She even wins the autumn Tenno Sho, showing that no distance is too great for the true wind to cover.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Burning with a determination that's second to none, Zephyr has realized her dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I'd like to reward her somehow, and show her how proud I am.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I ask her if there's anything she'd like in particular…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A reward? Hehe. From my point of view, it's you who's truly deserving of a benison breeze. That said…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I will embrace your comforting breeze… On one condition, that is.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Will you accompany me somewhere on our next day off?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, our day off arrives. After meeting Yamanin Zephyr at the academy gate, I'm whisked away to a certain location…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Can you hear the leaves rustling in the whispering wind?
choice_data_list: Yeah. This is an incredibly relaxing place.
Yeah. This is an incredibly relaxing place.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Your words are like windchimes to my ears.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But we're not here simply to bathe in the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A cheerful smile spreads across Yamanin Zephyr's face as she grabs my hand and weaves her fingers between mine. Her grip is firm but gentle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then, without a moment's delay…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's got me running as fast as my legs will carry me! While she's probably not even breaking a sweat, I'm sprinting desperately!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Give me more, Trainer. You have to be freer, and faster! Faster!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's not long before I'm out of breath and struggling to keep my eyes open. My view of Yamanin Zephyr's grinning face disappears beneath my eyelids…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: More, please. Hehe… More!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she jogs cheerfully on, the only thing that remains clear to me is the deep warmth of her fingertips clasping onto my hand.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Phew…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Breathing normally and still without a single drop of sweat on her, Yamanin Zephyr looks a picture compared to the pitiful mess I've become.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then she asks…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Do you understand now, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Actually, it's all right if you don't. We don't have to be on exactly the same wavelength.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I just want you to remember it all—everything your body felt just now.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Please don't forget. That was the wind—the true wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Faster than anything. Freer than anything. It blows on and on without end.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That is the wind… The same wind I yearned for more than anything.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And the same wind that you and I have become, together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: So, please, don't forget how it felt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although I'm out of breath, and I still feel a little dizzy…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I muster what remains of my strength to show her the biggest smile I can.
